title: Web Form Client Script Fails to Auto-fill Field from Linked DocType

posts.name: dormanie
posts.cooked:
Hello Frappe experts,

sorry for frequently asking things, but I am seeking help for an issue I have been trying to solve for a few days. I’m creating a Web Form (Supplier Product Proposal Form) and I need to automatically populate the Supplier field based on the logged-in user.

The Goal: To automatically fill a Link field with the fieldname supplier with the name of the Supplier document linked to the user currently accessing the Web Form.

My Current Setup:

  • Supplier DocType: I have a Supplier DocType which contains a child table named Supplier Portal User. This child table has a user field linked to the user’s email (e.g., supplier1@gmail.com).
  • Web Form: I have a Web Form with a Link field with the fieldname supplier that links to the Supplier DocType. This field is set as Mandatory.
  • Data: The user supplier1@gmail.com is a portal user and is correctly linked to a valid Supplier document.

Script I have tried (in the Web Form’s Client script):

`frappe.ready(function() {
    // This script searches the 'Supplier' DocType based on the user in the 'Supplier Portal User' child table
    frappe.call({
        method: 'frappe.client.get_list',
        args: {
            doctype: 'Supplier',
            filters: [
                ['Supplier Portal User', 'user', '=', frappe.session.user]
            ],
            fields: ['name']
        },
        callback: function(r) {
            if (r.message && r.message.length > 0) {
                const supplierName = r.message[0].name;
                frappe.web_form.set_value('supplier', supplierName);
            }
        }
    });
});`

The Problem:

  • When I open the Web Form, the Supplier field is always empty.
  • When I try to save the form without filling the field, I get the error “Missing Values Required: Supplier”.
  • On one occasion, I also got the error “Could not find Supplier: 13”, which indicated the script was pulling an incorrect value. After I fixed the script, the error reverted back to “Missing Value”.
  • I have already tried clearing the browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+R).

My Question: Could you please help me figure out why this script is not successfully populating the Supplier field? Is there an error in the script or a missing configuration step that I overlooked? Any help would be greatly appreciated.
